name: What does sub-trade coordination for plumbing involve during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What does sub-trade coordination for plumbing involve during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sub-trade coordination for plumbing means the general contractor schedules, manages, and oversees licensed plumbing specialists within a broader remodel. At HH Remodeling LLC, owner Abraham Becerra acts as your single point of contact on site. While our internal crew handles the carpentry, framing, drywall, and custom tile installation, we coordinate the plumbing specialists to run supply lines, rough-in valves, and set waste pipes at the exact construction stages required. This prevents miscommunication between separate trades, keeps structural framing aligned with pipe layouts, and eliminates the hassle of managing multiple individual contractors yourself.
acceptedAnswer.description: It means your general contractor schedules and oversees licensed plumbing specialists alongside carpentry, drywall, and tile to ensure seamless installation and scheduling.
